footer.disclaimer: moveandinvest compares rules and does not provide legal services. Nothing on this site is legal or tax advice.
footer.invite: Didn’t find your answer? Write to us — a person replies, not an autoresponder.

cookies.label: Cookies
cookies.body: We use analytics cookies to see how the site is read. Declining breaks nothing — every part of it works the same either way, and you can change your mind whenever you like.

country.costIntro: The threshold is the investment alone. Transfer taxes, professional and government fees and the first renewal are not optional — everyone pays them, every time.
country.ctaBody: One partner works in each jurisdiction, and an enquiry reaches only them — and only if you tick the consent box. A person replies, usually within one working day.

notFound.heading: That page is not here
notFound.body: Either the address has a typo in it, or the page moved when a jurisdiction was rewritten. The comparison table is the fastest way back in — it lists every jurisdiction the site covers, with a link to each.

brief.heading: Tell us what you are looking for
brief.intro: Three answers are enough to start: a budget, a place, and what the property is for. It goes to the one partner who works in this jurisdiction, and they reply to you directly.
brief.cityHint: As specific as you can be. If you already know the answer changes with the district — as it does in Athens and in Lisbon — say which one.
brief.consentLabel: I agree that this brief is passed to the partner who works in this jurisdiction.
brief.fine: We do not sell property and take no percentage of any transaction. Your brief goes to one partner, not to a list.

sent.title: Sent.
sent.body: We pass it on within one working day. The reply comes from the partner, to the address you gave.

error.title: That did not go through.
error.body: An email address and the consent box are the two things we cannot proceed without. Everything else is optional.

broke.title: That is on us.
broke.body: The brief did not reach us — the fault is at our end, not in what you filled in. Write to {email} and we will pick it up from there.

alerts.heading: We write when a rule changes
alerts.body: Not a newsletter. A short email when a threshold, a tax or a requirement in one of these jurisdictions becomes something else — with the statute and the date. There will not be many: across 2026 there have been fewer than ten such changes across five countries. The confirmation brings the four routes compared on one printable sheet.
alerts.jurisdictionsHint: Optional. Leave them all unticked and you get all five.
alerts.consentLabel: Send me an email when a rule changes. I can unsubscribe by replying to any of them.
alerts.fine: We keep the address and nothing else, and pass it to nobody.

sent.title: You are on the list.
sent.body: A confirmation is on its way, with the four-route comparison as a PDF. It also says what you signed up for and how to leave — one word in a reply.

error.title: That did not go through.
error.body: An email address and the checkbox are the two things we cannot proceed without.

broke.title: That is on us.
broke.body: The subscription did not reach us — the fault is at our end. Write to {email} and we will add you by hand.
